 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 28/11/2018, PASSED IN MVC NO.629/2018, ON THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MACT-V, CHITRADURGA,
PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the claimants-appellants under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'MV Act' for short), challenging the judgment and award passed in MVC No.629/2018 dated 28.11.2018 by the Court of II Addl.
Senior
Civil Judge & Addl. MACT,
Chitradurga
seeking enhancement of the compensation

The undisputed facts are that on 08.01.2018 at about 10.00 p.m., while the deceased-Pradeep Kumar was proceeding in his Motorcycle bearing registration No.KA- 16-EC-2445 from Kyadigere,
in order to reach Chitradurga on left side of the road, the driver of the Car bearing registration No.KA-04-MS-3238 coming from Hiriyur side in a rash and negligent manner had dashed against the motor cycle, due to which, the deceased sustained grievous injuries and immediately after the accident he was shifted to District Hospital, Chitradurga and died.
3. The claimants being the mother and brother of the deceased have preferred to file claim petition seeking compensation.

4. The Tribunal after considering the facts and circumstances and appreciating the material on record, has granted a compensation of Rs.7,74,000/- with interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of realization.

2 NC: 2024:KHC:6828 5.
Learned counsel for the appellants/claimants submitted that the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal is meager one and prays for enhancement of compensation.
6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent No.2 submitted that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and therefore, prays for dismissal of the appeal.
7. The Tribunal has granted the compensation under the various heads as follows:
Sl . No

. Particulars Amount (in.Rs.)
1. Towards loss of dependency Rs.7,14,000.00 2.
Towards loss of love and Rs.30,000.00 affection 3.
Towards loss of estate Rs.15,000.00 5.
Towards transportation of Rs.15,000.00 dead body and obsequies ceremonies
Being aggrieved by the lesser quantum of compensation, the present appeal is filed.
9. In the present case, the deceased was aged 28 years and he was working as computer operator in KEB sub station.

The Tribunal has considered the notional income of the deceased at Rs.7,000/-
p.m. which is on the lesser side.
The accident is of the year 2018.
Therefore, in the absence of any proof of income, the notional income of the deceased is taken as Rs.12,500/- p.m. as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
The Tribunal has not added 40% of the income toward future prospects.

Therefore, 40% of the income is to be added as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and others reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680.

sentences.text: Since the deceased was a bachelor, 50% of his income has to be deducted towards his personal expenditure.
The deceased was aged about 28 years at the time of the accident.
Therefore, the appropriate NC: 2024:KHC:6828 multiplier applicable to his age is '17'.
Therefore, the loss of dependency is hereby re-
assessed and quantified as under:

Accordingly, a sum of Rs.17,85,000/- is awarded under the head 'loss of dependency'.
10.
The Tribunal has granted compensation of Rs.30,000/- under the head 'loss of love and affection' which is on the lesser side.
The loss of consortium and loss of love and affection are more or less the similar ones.
The claimants are the mother and brother of the deceased.

As per the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Magma General Insurance Company Limited v.

As per the dictum of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Rasmita Biswal vs. Div.
Manager, National NC: 2024:KHC:6828 Insurance Co., Ltd., reported in AIR 2022 SC 85, for every three years 10% income is to be raised.

sentences.text: Therefore, a sum of Rs.44,000/- each is awarded under the head 'loss of consortium'.
Accordingly, a sum of Rs.88,000/- is awarded under the head 'loss of consortium'.

11. The Tribunal has granted a sum of Rs.15,000/- under the head 'loss of estate' and Rs.15,000/-
towards 'transportation of dead body & obsequies ceremony' which is on the lower side.

Therefore, it is just and reasonable to award a sum of Rs.16,500/- under the head 'loss of estate' and Rs.16,500/-
under the head 'transportation of dead body & obsequies ceremony'.
12.

Thus, in all, the claimants are entitled for the following sums:
Sl.

No . Particulars Amount (in.Rs.)
1. Towards loss of dependency Rs.17,85,000.00 2. Towards loss of love and Rs.88,000.00 affection NC: 2024:KHC:6828 3

. Towards loss of estate Rs.16,500.00 5. Towards transportation of dead Rs.16,500.00 body and obsequies ceremonies Total Rs. 19,06,000/-
13.
The Tribunal has awarded the compensation of Rs.7,74,000/-, but the appellants/claimants are entitled to total compensation of Rs.19,06,000/-.

Therefore, the appellants/claimants are entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.11,32,000/- (19,06,000-7,74,000) with interest at the rate of 6% p.a.,
from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.

14. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The judgment and award passed by the Tribunal in MVC No.629/2018 is hereby modified holding that the claimants are entitled for enhanced NC: 2024:KHC:6828 compensation of Rs.11,32,000/- with interest @ 6% p.a., from the date of petition till its realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
iii. Registry is directed to transmit the TCR along with copy of this order to the Tribunal forthwith.
iv. The claimants are not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 53 days in filing the appeal.
v. Costs made easy.

vi. Draw award accordingly.
